2122021813496537110.en_summary: StockSavvyShay notes AI token volume has grown ~25x since January with agents driving most of it, yet AI stocks selling off as if cycle ending. Widening disconnect between accelerating demand and falling prices makes drawdown interesting even if selling continues for weeks. Adding to $DOCN, $SITM and $ALAB as all benefit from same inference buildout: DigitalOcean hosting growing workloads, SiTime keeping distributed systems in sync, Astera Labs moving increasing data volumes between chips.
2122021813496537110.zh_summary: StockSavvyShay指出自一月以來AI令牌量增長約25倍，代理現在驅動大部分，但AI股票正在拋售，仿彻週期結束。加速需求與下跌股價之間的擴大脫節使這次回調有趣，即使知道拋售可能持續數週。正在加倉$DOCN、$SITM和$ALAB，因為三者以不同方式受益於同一推理建設：DigitalOcean託管增長工作負載，SiTime保持分佈式系統同步，Astera Labs在芯片之間移動增加的數據量。

2121928196677599642.en_summary: StockSavvyShay notes Raymond James sees cloud capex climbing to ~$1.5T in 2027 implying more than $500B in additional spending next year alone. Bigger shift is neoclouds becoming largest capex bucket at ~$400B while $GOOGL overtakes $AMZN among the hyperscalers. Puts $CRWV, $NBIS and $IREN in fastest-growing part of the buildout but also where access to capital matters most.
2121928196677599642.zh_summary: StockSavvyShay指出Raymond James預期2027年雲資本支出攀升至約1.5萬億美元，意味著僅明年就有超過5000億美元額外支出。更大轉變是新雲成為最大資本支出桶約4000億美元，而$GOOGL在超大規模雲中超越$AMZN。這使$CRWV、$NBIS和$IREN處於建設中增長最快的部分，但也是資本獲取最重要的部分。

2121926008911577244.en_summary: (Reposted by @DougKass) Gene Munster explains why $NVDA may not give guidance Tuesday night: 1. Management changes make it difficult for the new CFO to own the guide. 2. Risk of tighter US Commerce restrictions on Asia sales, estimate about 10% of revenue potentially at risk (China/HK 8%, other 2%). Some estimates go to 20%. Could pressure shares next week. Does not change the fact the company is in a solid position for next year. Links WSJ article.
2121926008911577244.zh_summary: (由@DougKass轉發) Gene Munster解釋為什麼$NVDA可能在週二晚上不提供指引：1. 管理層變動使新CFO難以擁有指引。2. 美國商務部對亞洲銷售更嚴格限制的風險，估計約10%收入可能面臨風險（中國/香港8%，其他2%）。一些估計高達20%。可能在下週對股價施壓。並不改變公司明年處於穩固位置的事實。附WSJ文章連結。
